title: Dimension-free regimes for unadjusted Langevin in ridge-separable models: A subspace robust Wasserstein analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.31431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) is widely used for high-dimensional Bayesian inference. Classical analyses in Wasserstein-2 distance predict an asymptotic bias and a mixing time that grow with dimension, but this metric is stronger than necessary for many statistical tasks. We instead analyze the bias in subspace robust Wasserstein distance, which controls the mean and arbitrary low-dimensional marginals and is therefore well suited to observables typically estimated in practice. For ridge-separable potentials formed with i.i.d. data, we prove high-probability bounds showing a bell-shaped mixing profile as the number of data points $N$ varies relative to the dimension $d$. In the overparameterized regime, the effective dimension is the rank $N$ of the data-dependent perturbation, leading to complexity depending on $N$ rather than $d$. translated_title: 岭可分模型中未调整朗之万算法的无维度区间：基于子空间鲁棒Wasserstein距离的分析
translated_abstract: 未调整朗之万算法（ULA）被广泛应用于高维贝叶斯推断。基于Wasserstein-2距离的经典分析预测了随维度增长的渐近偏差和混合时间，但这一度量对于许多统计任务而言强于实际需要。我们转而分析子空间鲁棒Wasserstein距离下的偏差，该距离能够控制均值和任意低维边缘分布，因此非常适合实践中通常估计的观测量。对于由独立同分布数据构成的岭可分势函数，我们证明了高概率界，表明当数据点数量N相对维度d变化时，混合过程呈现钟形曲线。在过参数化区间中，有效维度是数据依赖扰动的秩N，使得复杂度依赖于N而非d。在大样本区间中，高斯扰动估计产生了无维度的复杂度……
tldr: 该论文利用子空间鲁棒Wasserstein距离分析未调整朗之万算法在岭可分模型中的偏差，证明在过参数化和大样本区间下算法复杂度可摆脱对维度的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the bias of the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm in ridge-separable models via subspace robust Wasserstein distance, proving dimension-free complexity in both overparameterized and large-sample regimes.
